reasoning: Recent Texas Senate polling from the last 45 days shows a very close race, with several polls giving Democrat James Talarico a narrow edge and the most recent Emerson poll showing Republican Ken Paxton up 1. The weight of the recent polling suggests Texas is currently best described as R+1 at most, effectively a toss-up in the Senate race; Texas’s statewide Cook PVI remains R+10.0.

sources.name: Fox News via The Hill
sources.details: Fox News found Talarico leading Paxton 51% to 48% among registered Texas voters, a 3-point Democratic edge within the poll’s margin of error.

sources.name: Texas Southern University / Barbara Jordan Public Policy Research and Survey Center
sources.details: Texas Southern University’s Barbara Jordan Public Policy Research and Survey Center found Talarico ahead of Paxton 47% to 45%, a 2-point Democratic edge.

sources.name: Texas Public Opinion Research
sources.details: Texas Public Opinion Research found Talarico leading Paxton 45% to 40%, a 5-point Democratic edge.

sources.name: Emerson College Polling/Nexstar Media
sources.details: Emerson College Polling/Nexstar found Paxton at 47% and Talarico at 46%, a 1-point Republican edge and the latest single poll in the set.

sources.name: Texas Politics Project U.S. Senate Poll Tracker
sources.details: The Texas 2026 U.S. Senate Poll Tracker compiles recent public polls and shows the latest average with Paxton at 47 and Talarico at 46 in Emerson, while prior polls had Talarico slightly ahead; this is a tracking/index source rather than a standalone poll.
